description: Change title, description, tags, category or privacy of a video on a connected channel. privacy 'public' is ALWAYS parked for approval and runs only after a human admin approves it in the app. Never deletes.

privacy.description: New visibility; public is always parked for admin approval

video_id.description: ID of the video to change
